svg.aria-label: フランス領ギアナの正確な海岸線・国境と8景の位置
svg.metadata: French Guiana: GSHHG/GSHHS intermediate-resolution data via Basemap (WGS84; GSHHG geography distributed under GNU LGPL-3.0; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/pwessel/gshhg/). Internal sovereign borders from bundled Basemap border linework. The cross-dataset source river-mouth self-intersection is resolved with Shapely buffer(0); no manually invented coastlines, islands, or internal waterways. Île Royale is shown as a georeferenced point rather than a coastline polygon. Inland reservoir shore and water use the same GSHHG source. Fixed local-equirectangular-fit-v1 projection, map bounds -55.5,1.8,-50.8,6.2. Not for navigation.
